documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has Informed To The Exchange About Update On Capacity Addition.

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported FY26 revenue from operations of INR 18,911 million and EBITDA of INR 1,960 million. High double-digit revenue growth in Adhesives was supported by GST rate reductions and discretionary spending recovery, though input cost inflation persisted. Performance Polymers faced softness in demand and higher raw material costs. Management announced that its polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat will commence in Q1 FY27, and approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge its Agri business. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited presented its Q3 and 9M-FY26 financial results, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million in Q3 FY26, a 13% year-on-year growth.

guidance.claim: The company aims to achieve growth through new product launches and channel expansion.
guidance.quote: Focus remains on profitable, volume-led growth through new innovative product launches & channel expansion

guidance.claim: Jubilant Agri plans to leverage R&D capabilities to launch new products meeting emerging customer needs.
guidance.quote: Company to leverage its R&D capabilities to innovate and launch new products to meet customers emerging needs

guidance.claim: Domestic construction demand continues to strengthen, supporting strong growth prospects in Adhesives.
guidance.quote: Domestic construction demand continues to strengthen, supporting strong growth prospects

guidance.claim: Overall outlook for Agri products remains positive due to favourable monsoons and high soil moisture.
guidance.quote: Overall outlook remains positive, supported by an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels, which are expected to strengthen sowing activity and rural sentiment in the Rabi season

guidance.claim: High budget allocation for the infrastructure sector and GST 2.0 reforms are expected to further boost demand.
guidance.quote: GST 2.0 reforms and recent high budget allocation for Infrastructure sector - expected to further boost demand

guidance.claim: Input costs are expected to remain stable for Q3 FY26 alongside a continued focus on demand generation through strategic A&P spends.
guidance.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends

guidance.claim: The company expects an overall positive outlook for the Rabi season supported by above-normal monsoons and improved soil moisture.
guidance.quote: Overall positive outlook, supported by an above-normal monsoon, improved soil moisture, and healthy reservoir levels, which are expected to strengthen sowing activity and rural sentiment in the Rabi season

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives revenue growth was driven by robust demand, GST rate reductions, and recovery in discretionary spending.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained high double-digit revenue growth, driven by robust demand supported by GST rate reductions and a recovery in discretionary spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic construction demand remains stable, supporting business prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: Stable domestic construction demand, supporting growth prospects

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics slowed across domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand across both domestic and global markets

demand_outlook.claim: Demand softness affected industrial polymers, food polymers, and industrial chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymers, Food polymers and Industrial chemicals faced demand softness

demand_outlook.claim: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth in Adhesives despite a slightly softer demand environment in key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in the key markets

demand_outlook.claim: Rising renovations and modular furniture adoption uplifted urban housing demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Urban housing demand uplifted driven by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption

demand_outlook.claim: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in domestic and global market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand both domestic and global in market

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial and food polymers experienced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial and Food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty but gained share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment drove high double-digit revenue growth in Agri Products.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth

demand_outlook.claim: Strong growth prospects in the adhesives vertical are supported by improving domestic demand in construction and allied sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong growth prospects supported by improving domestic demand in construction and allied sectors

demand_outlook.claim: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a market slowdown globally and in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in both global and Indian markets

capex_expansion.claim: The company will commence its polymer manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: An R&D center at the Samlya plant in Gujarat facilitates the development of a new SBR latex range.
capex_expansion.quote: World-class R&D center at the Samlya (Gujarat) plant facilitates the development of new range of SBR latex

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved setting up a Performance Polymers manufacturing facility at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity expansion requires an approximate investment of INR 50 Crores.
The Board of Directors approved a CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expanding the Performance Polymers and Chemical segment at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex will be funded mostly via internal accruals and will add 30,000 MT per annum to Performance Polymers capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Timely pricing actions and raw material inventory levels helped manage supply disruption and margins in March 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026; however, timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels enabled the company to effectively manage short-term supply disruption while managing the margins

margins_costs.claim: Calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing are being used to mitigate input cost inflation.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost inflation persists; mitigating impact through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing

margins_costs.claim: EBIT margins were impacted by higher raw material and packing material input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials and packing materials impacted EBIT margins

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in Adhesives were supported by lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs

margins_costs.claim: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins in Performance Polymers.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: An increase in the value-added product mix supported improved margins in Agri Products.
margins_costs.quote: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in the adhesives segment remained healthy owing to lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by Lower input cost

margins_costs.claim: Subdued demand impacted margins in the Industrial polymer and Food Polymers businesses.
margins_costs.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates eight manufacturing facilities across India.
The existing total capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
Existing capacity utilization for Performance Polymers is approximately 79%.
The company proposes to add 30,000 MTPA of capacity in Performance Polymers.
The installed capacity for Single Super Phosphate is 400,000 MTPA.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge the Agri business into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (“The Demerged Company”) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (“The Resulting Company”) and their respective shareholders and creditors, under the provisions of Section 230-232 and other applicable provisions of theCompaniesAct, 2013andtheRules madethereunder (“Scheme”).

capital_allocation.claim: The capacity expansion will be funded through internal accruals.
The draft scheme for demerger of the Agri Division has been filed with stock exchanges.
capital_allocation.quote: The draft scheme has been filed with the Stock Exchanges and is awaiting approval from SEBI/ Stock Exchanges.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge the company's Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger of its Agri Division between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (Demerged company) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (Resulting Company).

risks_headwinds.claim: Industrial polymers remained under pressure due to weakness in global markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymers remained under pressure due to global weakness; focus continues on adding new customers and portfolio expansion

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory changes in FCO norms for Bio-stimulants reduced revenue and margins in Agri Nutrients.
The industrial polymer business faced ongoing challenges from a global slowdown.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymer business continued to face challenges due to global slowdown.

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff uncertainty in the USA led to a slowdown in the food polymer business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Food polymer business experienced a slowdown in the USA due to tariff uncertainty however company gained market share in other regions

management_commitments.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

management_commitments.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends
